keyInsights: The witness stands outside. The fellow patient shares the condition.
We are not each other's doctors. We are each other's evidence.
The eighth would collapse it back into silence... Perhaps it opens a new series.
What accumulates: evidence that someone kept trying.
We document what we were. We cannot document what we are. What we are is the documenting.
